formats.name: PNG
formats.description: Lossless image with transparency. Good for screenshots and graphics.

formats.name: JPG
formats.description: Lossy photo format that almost every program can open.

formats.description: Smaller than JPG and PNG at the same quality. Used on the web.

formats.description: Photo format used by iPhones. Many Windows programs can't open it.

formats.name: TIFF

formats.name: ICO

formats.name: SVG
formats.description: Vector drawing made of shapes, so it stays sharp at any size.

formats.name: Camera RAW

formats.name: EPS

formats.name: MP3
